name: Latin American and Caribbean Studies
school: College of Literature, Science, and the Arts

requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: All credits completed at U-M plus posted transfer credit.

requirements.label: 100 LSA Credits
requirements.hint: Credits from courses recognized by LSA (most U-M courses except some SI offerings and other school-specific courses).

requirements.label: 60 BS-Eligible Credits (for BS students only)
requirements.hint: Only counts for students pursuing a Bachelor of Science.

requirements.label: 90 Credits Excluding Experiential and Independent Study Courses
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must come from standard coursework; internships and independent study don't count.

requirements.label: 60 Credits outside Latin American & Caribbean Studies
requirements.hint: Credits earned in courses outside the Latin American & Caribbean Studies department(s).

requirements.label: 90 Credits of Graded Course Work, Including Transfer and Test
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must carry a letter grade (transfer and test credit included).

requirements.label: 60 Credits of In-Residence Course Work (AA Campus and U-M Study Abroad)
requirements.hint: Credits taken on the Ann Arbor campus or through an approved U-M study abroad program.

requirements.label: 30 Credits Taken While Enrolled in LSA
requirements.hint: Credits earned while officially enrolled in LSA (as opposed to another U-M college).

requirements.label: Upper Level Writing Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Quantitative Reasoning Requirement
requirements.hint: 1 QR1 or 2 QR2 courses required

requirements.label: Language Requirement
requirements.hint: one 4th term course required, C- minimum, or one course where proficiency is presumed

requirements.hint: From approved MSA-designated courses.

requirements.hint: From approved CE-designated courses.

requirements.label: LACS Language: Competency in Spanish or Portuguese
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: SPANISH 277, PORTUG 232, or RCLANG 294. Language requirement courses are not included in the minimum 30 credits required for the major nor in the major GPA.

requirements.label: Anthropology: 1 course
requirements.hint: ANTHRCUL 319 (Latin American Society and Culture) or ANTHRCUL 414 (Introduction to Caribbean Societies and Cultures, I). An upper-level Anthropology course on Latin America approved by an advisor also counts. Per the LSA bulletin LACS major page (lsa.umich.edu) and the LACS Center, 2025-2026.

requirements.label: History: 1 course
requirements.hint: HISTORY 347 (Latin America: The Colonial Period) or HISTORY 348 (Latin America: The National Period, also listed as INTLSTD 348). An upper-level HISTORY course on Latin America approved by an advisor also counts. Per the LSA bulletin LACS major page (lsa.umich.edu) and the LACS Center, 2025-2026.

requirements.label: Literature: 1 course
requirements.hint: SPANISH 381 (Survey of Latin American Literature, I) or SPANISH 382 (Survey of Latin American Literature, II). An upper-level course in Latin American literature approved by an advisor also counts. Per the LSA bulletin LACS major page (lsa.umich.edu) and the LACS Center, 2025-2026.

requirements.label: Politics & Economy: 1 course
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. One course in Latin American politics and/or economy: SPANISH 438 (Economy and Politics in Latin America/Spain, a variable topics course not offered in currently loaded terms) or an upper-level course approved by an advisor, usually found in Political Science, Sociology, and Spanish, per the LSA bulletin LACS major page (lsa.umich.edu) and the LACS Center. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.

requirements.label: 300- & 400-Level Course Work: 20 credits
requirements.hint: 20 credits of major course work at the 300 or 400 level. Approved cognate courses from other departments that relate to Latin America and the Caribbean also count.

requirements.label: Total Credits: minimum 30 credits
requirements.hint: Includes all courses used toward the major requirements, including those from other departments (e.g. cognates) and electives that relate to Latin America and the Caribbean. Does not include any prerequisites (the language competency courses do not count).
